description: The ophys module on synthetic recordings with known shifts and cells: SciScan raw, TIFF and multi-ROI ScanImage files are read, the data variables are set up by the module's tool, and motion correction, image statistics (a computed fragment), ROI detection (the correlation image, and Quicky's), signal extraction, ΔF/F, deconvolution, denoising, downsampling, aligning sessions, ROI curation, the viewer's frames and projections (std and local correlation), a method previewed on the first frames (writing nothing), methods run on frames firstFrame..lastFrame only (also in a preview, which takes the first frames of that range), every plane of a two-plane recording processed in one run (plane 0: the aligned planes in one stack, the projections a frame per plane, the ROIs of both planes in one file with their places, and the signals of each ROI from its own plane), the recordings' frame rate, pixel size and z step read from their files (data.frame's metadata) and written into the session's columns by ophys.read_metadata, and the brain region at a FOV's position give the values of the ground truth, which make_data.py computes from the scenes directly (the deconvolution with a general optimiser). The module's dashboard page and its atlas are served by app.plugins and modules.resource; the FOV map's injection sites are kept with modules.saveData, as JSON text given back exactly.
